reason: Refresh #505 SOR after adding rollback exercise and terminal finish/cleanup canary evidence while preserving the absent operator approval gate.

operation.summary: Reconciled PR #591 with current main, consumed terminal V3-H readback evidence, proved the pre-cutover rollback and terminal finish/cleanup canary lanes, kept C-SDLC v3 deferred as non-authoritative pending explicit operator approval, and strengthened the #505 validator so the evidence cannot silently regress.
changes: Added `csdlc finish --observe-github`, which uses a constrained read-only GitHub adapter with child-process credential injection to observe merged PR and closed issue truth instead of accepting caller-authored terminal readbacks.
Ran the observed finish canary against merged PR #641 and closed issue #629 at exact head `8ad0d56ae7db6421fcbc2016a2f1c8590094577e`, deriving `terminal_closed_out` with `performed_mutation=false`.

Created a registered clean detached cleanup canary worktree at `/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-629-terminal-cleanup-canary` from PR #641's exact head to exercise cleanup against actual Git worktree registration.
Ran v3 clean preview with a durable terminal receipt under `.csdlc/evidence/505/`, producing a removable decision and cleanup receipt digest without deleting anything.
Ran v3 clean with `remove=true` and the preview digest, proving removal is denied before #505 cutover authority and the worktree remains present at the exact #641 head.
Ran the v3 cutover route with an explicit no-approval request, proving it blocks on missing operator, missing approval, and missing #505 approval while staying read-only.
Ran typed C-SDLC v2 validation after the v3 canaries, proving the pre-cutover rollback target remains usable as live lifecycle authority.

Updated `docs/csdlc-v3/CUTOVER_READINESS_NOTICE.md` and `docs/csdlc-v3/authority-transition-disposition.json` so rollback and terminal canary evidence are satisfied and explicit operator approval is the remaining pre-merge authority gate.

Strengthened `.csdlc/prepared/issues/505/validate-authority-transition-prep.rb` to require the rollback exercise, terminal finish canary, cleanup preview, cleanup removal-denial canary, and cutover approval-denial canary.
Kept PR #591 non-closing for #505; this work does not approve cutover, merge, finish #505, clean worktrees, or retire v2.
